title: PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy with the UserDefaults reason declared
acceptance: PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy exists in the app target and declares the UserDefaults required-reason API used by Stacks/Services/AppGroup.swift
The reason code declared is the app-group shared defaults one
Collected data types are declared as none, matching the Data Not Collected label
The file is bundled by the build, not merely present on disk
notes: App Store blocking, small, mechanical, objectively checkable. The best first calibration task for the factory.
